answer: Trust should climb a public trellis, not appear overnight. First, each newcomer registers one non-transferable onyx identity and publishes every job on an open ledger. Second, three random established auditors verify each job; a false approval costs each auditor 200 tokens and a 60-day suspension. Third, newcomers stay on a small knoll: at most five low-value deals a day for 90 days, rising only after 100 verified jobs. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 1,000,000 jobs and 300,000 audit hours, over $6 million. Like a vine, trust earns height only by holding on at every rung.
